target.title: [codex] Fix Kimi rate limit ordering
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes Kimi's quota presentation so the short rate-limit window is shown before the weekly quota without changing persisted metric lane semantics.

- Keeps Kimi `primary` as `Weekly` and `secondary` as `Rate Limit`, preserving existing `menuBarMetricPreferences` behavior.
- Reorders the Kimi menu-card display layer to show the rate-limit lane before the weekly lane when both are available.
- Keeps the automatic menu-bar metric selecting the rate-limit lane first, with fallback to weekly-only accounts.
- Treats malformed or non-positive Kimi rate-limit payloads as unavailable so weekly-only accounts still render a useful metric.
- Adds regression coverage for menu-card ordering, parser conversion, weekly-only fallback, malformed rate limits, animation, and highest-usage selection.

## Root Cause

Kimi already stores weekly quota as `primary` and the 5-hour rate limit as `secondary`, and user metric preferences persist those raw lane names. The bug was that the generic menu-card order rendered `primary` before `secondary`, even though Kimi's more constrained rate-limit window should be presented first. The fix keeps the stored lane meanings and automatic resolver behavior stable, and applies the ordering only at the display layer.

## Relation To #1762

#1762 includes the same invariant conceptually as part of broader Kimi Code work, but it remains open and explicitly held for additional gates. This PR is the narrow current-main fix for #1912 so the user-visible quota ordering can land independently.

Fixes #1912.

## Validation

- `swift test --filter KimiUsageSnapshotConversionTests`
- `swift test --filter KimiUsageResponseParsingTests`
- `swift test --filter ProviderInlineDashboardModelTests`
- `swift test --filter StatusItemAnimationTests`
- `swift test --filter UsageStoreHighestUsageTests`
- `swift test --filter UsageStoreCoverageTests`
- `make check`
- `make test`

## Maintainer verification

- Rebased on current `main`; exact verified head: `6934e68c7e7ee46cc0da4d30c09332bc0faf5209`.
- Packaged and signed a debug 0.40.1 app from that head.
- Authenticated Kimi Code API returned both live windows: Weekly `0/100 requests` and Rate Limit `0/100 per 5 hours`.
- Packaged menu rendered Rate Limit before Weekly and kept that order after closing and reopening the menu.
- Provider Settings retained `Primary (Weekly)` and `Secondary (Rate Limit)`, preserving stored lane preferences.
- Focused Kimi/menu/settings suites, all 48 full-suite shards, `make check`, and two autoreview passes completed cleanly.
